scope: 21 navigation, hierarchy, shell-header and editor families
evidence: All 21 families inspected through complete high-fidelity get_design_context responses and screenshots. No sparse response was used. Metadata confirms each family variant ID; supplemental individual variant requests stopped at the shared Figma plan quota. Complete family responses contain all state branches.

conventions.fonts: Aptos body at400/700, with source IBM Plex Sans notification/search/support exceptions and Arial help glyph. Root font manifest owns licensed assets.
conventions.strokes: Inside strokes use inset rings or positioned rules where border-box layout would alter measured padding.
conventions.data: Business examples live only in navigation-preview.tsx. These presentation components contain no Dataverse transport, browser storage, persistence or product iframe.
conventions.assets: 188 exact SVG references downloaded without path editing. navigation-icons.tsx imports local @/assets/snapp/navigation sources and preserves natural SVG root dimensions.
conventions.verification: Portable Chromium gate passes across21 families/51 variants with179 geometry, typography, asset and interaction assertions. Every popup variant is explicitly activated before its state screenshot; family overviews alone are not popup evidence. Intrinsic text metrics are recorded separately and no business-label width is forced.

families.name: Tabbed Header Navigation
families.purpose: Switch the current work or approvals section while keeping an achievement summary visible.
families.implementation: TabbedHeaderNavigation composes Radix Tabs; normal pill Tabs remain a separate display variant.

families.name: Tree Menu
families.purpose: Search and select grouped assigned records in a narrow cabinet or Snapp side panel.
families.implementation: TreeMenu owns the panel; Tree recipe='menu' supplies compact leaf rows and closed-folder icon styling. Source example records are fixture-only.

families.name: Row
families.purpose: Compact structured record row with identifier, title, category, progress, date, status action and trailing indicator.
families.implementation: TreeRow offers named semantic slots and a native status-action callback; Progress reuses the shared primitive.

families.name: Row Title
families.purpose: Name a group of structured record rows, with a folder glyph and aligned trailing-column space.
families.implementation: TreeRowTitle supplies exact fixed trailing slots when used with its label API, or accepts composed children.

families.name: Tree Item
families.purpose: Selectable, unavailable, insertion, creation or notification state of one tree leaf.
families.implementation: TreeItem is keyboard focusable, supports an independent menu callback, optional native dragging and exact state-specific SVGs. Data and dates are supplied by the consumer.

families.name: Tree Folder
families.purpose: Expandable container in a record hierarchy, with the same six visual states as a leaf.
families.implementation: TreeFolder extends the shared tree item, exposes aria-expanded, uses exact open/closed/disabled folder exports, and keeps expand state separate from menu actions.

families.name: Pagination
families.purpose: Move through explicit groups of weeks or result pages with previous, next and overflow indicators.
families.implementation: Existing link API preserved; selected state uses aria-current and the Figma brand outline rather than a filled button.

families.name: Tree
families.purpose: Explore a nested domain hierarchy and select records at multiple levels.
families.implementation: Tree uses data-driven nodes and the hierarchy recipe. Keyboard navigation supports arrows, Home/End and first-letter traversal; expand and selection are independently controlled. Full source business example is not distributed as product data.

families.name: Tree Builder
families.purpose: Author a nested service catalogue hierarchy using item/folder, insertion, add and selected states.
families.implementation: TreeBuilder supports both data-driven nodes and composed tree children with shared keyboard navigation. The faithful preview uses exact source mixed268px catalogue cards,28px editable rows, source indent rules and original family SVGs. Small optional menu/lock icon overrides and label truncation control cover source differences. Domain records and mutations remain consumer-owned.

families.name: Profile Controls
families.purpose: Classic branded Shell bar with application launcher, logo, global actions, help and profile.
families.implementation: ProfileControls exposes explicit action identifiers to the host; exact exported logo and profile/action assets are local.

families.name: Left Menu
families.purpose: Branded vertical application navigation, feature groups, sign-out, area choice and current area.
families.implementation: BrandedSidebar owns visual geometry while the host supplies groups and callbacks. No application name or menu route is hardcoded in registry source.

families.name: Header
families.purpose: Compact screen title with optional trophy/achievement summary or filter and collapse actions.
families.implementation: FeatureHeader and AchievementSummary compose both variants and optional controls; title and counts are supplied.

families.name: Dynamics Menu
families.purpose: Light Dynamics-style navigation rail with collapsible primary sections, grouped links and an accent current-location mark.
families.implementation: DynamicsMenu is an independent navigation composition with aria-current, aria-expanded and host actions; generic Sidebar remains an accessible responsive layout primitive.

families.name: Side menu
families.purpose: Compose Dynamics navigation with form-manager tree and draggable form-element palette.
families.implementation: SideMenu composes independent DynamicsMenu and NavigationPanel surfaces. Form definitions and insert/reorder behavior are consumer-owned, not copied demo records.

families.name: Editor Toolbar
families.purpose: Control text emphasis, list styles and exclusive paragraph alignment.
families.implementation: EditorToolbar composes Radix multiple/single ToggleGroups with actual pressed states, accessible labels and controlled callbacks.

families.name: Sidebar
families.purpose: Search and filter a learning-goal hierarchy within a wide auxiliary panel.
families.implementation: NavigationPanel provides the surface/title/search/content slots; existing filter controls and Tree provide the remaining composition. Source example goals are fixture-only.

families.name: Updated Header
families.purpose: Primary navigation with an expanded feature menu, global search and searchable application chooser.
families.implementation: NavigationHeader variant='updated' shares application and feature data with the square variant. Portals use the injected container; full-width feature menu stays inside its header.

families.name: Tab Item
families.purpose: Select a section or expose the next level of a contextual navigation path.
families.implementation: Radix TabsTrigger handles default/selected states. ExpandedTab supplies two separate accessible navigation actions without nesting buttons or tab controls.

families.name: Tabbed Menu
families.purpose: Group horizontal section tabs in a rounded white container.
families.implementation: TabsList default variant is the Figma pill treatment; line variant is explicitly selected by the tabbed header.

families.name: Square Top Menu
families.purpose: Compact primary navigation with application, area, user, feature and support surfaces.
families.implementation: NavigationHeader variant='square' uses controlled Popovers, searches data-supplied apps and accepts host-owned area/user controls. LiveSupportPanel exposes message, close and expand callbacks; text messages remain dynamic.

families.name: Tool Menu
families.purpose: Show the current hierarchy path with optional date, search and active filter tools.
families.implementation: ToolMenu composes the shared single-pill FeatureBreadcrumb, collapses older labels to source '...' text, preserves accessible ancestor labels, and accepts existing filter controls.

knownBoundaries: All21 complete parent contexts and screenshots were inspected; additional per-child remote reads stopped at the shared Figma plan quota. Parent contexts include every assigned variant branch.

The registry owns presentation and local interaction state. Data mutations, storage, authorization and Dataverse callbacks remain consumer-owned; no business sample records, iframe, API transport or persistence were added to production navigation components.

Typography uses the exact source families and styles. Natural widths differ slightly between Figma integer text geometry and Chromium fractional glyph advances: pagination409.71875 vs413, Item59.421875 vs60, expanded tab130.84375 vs132, eight-item menu519.375 vs524. These measurements and the per-text-run tolerance are explicit in the portable gate; this audit does not claim bit-identical cross-platform text rasterization.

Browser verification is Chromium156.0.8078.4 on Windows at device scale1. Popup collision avoidance remains enabled; a3600px-tall fixture viewport makes the authored below-header popup variants visible without disabling production behavior.

pagination.reason: Intrinsic text metrics differ across Figma integer geometry and Chromium fractional advances; exact14/20 Aptos400,p8/12,gap4 preserved. No sample-specific widths are forced.
